metadata.description: The local marketplace of the worfy Harness. worfy copies this folder to ~/.claude/worfy-harness/plugin/ and registers it with `claude plugin marketplace add`; the folder is the marketplace and the plugin at once (source "./", ADR-0048).

plugins.name: worfy
plugins.description: The worfy Harness: rules, agents, skills, scripts and hooks of the epic → ticket → wave workflow
